verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only payment flows (card charges, authorization and capture, refunds, 3DS, POS) plus an llms.txt docs index. The recurring and scheduled charge features (kushki-docs-29, kushki-docs-30) are billing capabilities that belong to a subscriptions story, not a general facility for setting up autonomous automations, so they earn no credit here.
